author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video we take a look at and test out the all new MSI CUBI NUC 3MG. Powered by the wildly efficient new Intel Panther Lake Series 3 chips, this mini PC packs serious performance into a tiny footprint. With an Intel Core Ultra 9 386H, 16 cores, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and up to 100 TOPS of AI performance, it is an absolute beast.

While MSI designed this with business energy-efficiency and 24/7 runtimes in mind, it makes for a fantastic daily driver or personal desktop replacement. We run it through the gauntlet—from testing out the Copilot+ live AI translations to hitting benchmark scores that actually beat the M1 Max in Cinebench. Thanks to Intel's latest Arc drivers and XeSS Multi-frame generation, we even get Cyberpunk 2077 running smoothly at over 80 FPS, all while sipping as little as 6 watts of power at idle.
